crossRefs.note: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to Yahweh.
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
“Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
for my eyes have seen your salvation,
Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy…
She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

translations.web: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
translations.bsb: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
translations.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
translations.asv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
